subject: Complaint: umpire language at Saturdays Majors game

triage.summary: Howard Litvak complains that the home plate umpire used inappropriate language toward the visiting coaches at Saturday's Majors game, which children overheard and repeated, and asks what the board plans to do about it.
triage.proposed_action: Escalate to a human (board/umpire coordinator) for review of the umpire conduct incident; draft only a holding reply that acknowledges the complaint and promises a follow-up, without promising any specific disciplinary outcome.

details.audience: several children on the fence heard and repeated the language
details.issue: home plate umpire used inappropriate language toward the visiting coaches
details.requested_action: wants to know what the board plans to do about the incident

policy_reason: Policy: intent 'complaint' requires human decision (conflicts need a human touch)
